description: Spanish-profile khaprail tile in natural red clay, made by Pak Clay in Lahore. The curved, barrel-like profile gives the roof a classic Mediterranean look and is designed to carry rain down its channels. Fired clay is a traditional roofing material valued for its natural colour, which does not need repainting. It suits villas, farmhouses and restoration work. Request a free sample on WhatsApp to check the colour and shape, and send your roof area and city for a written, dated quote.

Terracotta red brick gutka tile in natural fired clay, made by Pak Clay in Lahore. The small red brick look suits outdoor walls, garden paths, porches and courtyards, and its warm colour comes from the clay itself rather than a coating. Clay is a traditional choice for hot climates. Tell us whether it is for a wall or a floor so we can advise. Ask for a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area for a written, dated quote.

Random-shape concrete otti tile for outdoor floors, from the Pak Clay catalogue. Irregular pieces are laid like crazy paving, which suits garden paths, patios, terraces and porches where a natural, informal look is wanted. Concrete is a hard-wearing material, and the random pattern helps hide joints and small differences between pieces. Request a free sample on WhatsApp to check the colour and surface, and send your area and city for a written, dated quote.

Natural sandstone-look wall cladding tile for house exteriors and facades, from the Pak Clay catalogue. The sand-toned stone face adds texture to front walls, boundary walls, feature panels and entrances, giving plain plaster a natural finish. Cladding is fixed to the wall face rather than used as flooring, so tell us the wall type when you ask. Get a free sample on WhatsApp to see the tone and texture in daylight, and send your wall area for a written, dated quote.
